Chapter 547: Chapter 5: The Strongest Strike (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 547: Chapter 5: The Strongest Strike (Subscription Request)_2

The value of a research planet is much higher than that of a high-level planet, especially when it is situated in such a large area as the Central Star Domain.

Moreover, the many computational power machines on the research planet are all automatically equipped, and there is also a large group of professors and expert teams at work.

Lin Yuan’s command concerning the research planet was to take on various challenges officially issued by human civilization and use the computational power of the planet to gradually conquer them.

So as to earn corresponding Merit Points.

In fact, if Lin Yuan were to preside over the research planet himself and tackle the various challenges of human civilization, he would earn even more Merit Points.

But it was not necessary; spending time solving the many challenges of human civilization? It would be somewhat of a waste of Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

...

…

Ten months later.

Lin Yuan traveled through almost half of human civilization’s territory and returned to the Milky Way Star Region.

“Finally back.”

Lin Yuan crossed five to six hundred light-years in one step, and soon he arrived at the Milky Way Main Star.

“This trip to the Central Star Domain took nearly two years,” Lin Yuan quietly appeared in the Star Lord’s Great Hall, exchanged a glance with the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, and sat down cross-legged.

This was still Lin Yuan constantly deploying the Great Transference Skill.

If he had chosen to travel by spaceship, it would probably take five to six years to return.

“Spatial Layers…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes slightly closed, feeling the layers upon layers of spatial layers within his inner world.

Although he spent most of the past two years traveling, Lin Yuan had not been delayed in his cultivation and practice of enlightenment. Over these nearly two years, Lin Yuan had reached forty-three thousand layers in his spatial layer development.

It is worth noting that when Lin Yuan first stepped into the Ninth Rank, the number of spatial layers he had developed was only thirty-nine thousand.

In less than two years, he had developed an additional four thousand spatial layers, a feat that would probably make other newly advanced Ninth Rank Evolvers green with envy.

“To step into the Ninth Rank with dozens of ordinary cosmic forces, more than ten high-level cosmic forces, and one Source-level Cosmic Force, developing spatial layers is almost like playing…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, according to his estimation, at most in ten years, he could reach the Hundred-Thousand Heavy Realm of the Ninth Rank, and it might not even take ten years.

Other ordinary Ninth Rank Evolvers, who initially only developed a single-digit number of spatial layers, consider each additional layer developed a trial by fire, and it might take tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years to develop to the Myriad Heavy Realm.

“However, cultivating is so easy for me, other Martial Arts Evolutionaries who step into the Ninth Rank will still need to gradually develop their spatial layers…”

Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

Even though he has yet to cultivate to the peak of the Ninth Rank, he needs to consider the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter for future generations of Martial Arts Evolutionaries, as it is almost impossible for them to replicate Lin Yuan’s path and comprehend the dozens of cosmic forces.

In fact, the vast majority of Eighth Stage Martial Arts Evolutionaries cannot comprehend cosmic forces.

Without the boost of cosmic forces, Ninth Stage Martial Arts Evolutionaries’ development of spatial layers has no noticeable advantage compared to other Ninth Rank Evolvers.

Those able to cultivate to the Ninth Rank have an evolutionary path that is immensely refined; the gap between the same-tier Martial Path Evolutionary Path and others is not as vast as one might think.

Of course, this excludes potential.

The Eighth Stage Martial Tao is assessed by the three goddesses to have a final value far exceeding other evolutionary paths of the Eighth Stage, having discovered the potential of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao and the birth of those who master cosmic forces is much higher than in other evolutionary paths.

“There’s also the Rule of Time, which I’ve been sensing over these two years, and I’m likely about to grasp the basics…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Comprehending the Rule of Time at the Eighth Rank is not at the same level of difficulty as at the Ninth Rank.

Currently, Lin Yuan can feel the fluctuations of the Rule of Time, and almost every minute and every second, his understanding of the Rule of Time is strengthened and deepened.

“Once I master the basics of the Rule of Time, I’ll be able to control time acceleration to a certain extent, which offers a significant enhancement in combat,” Lin Yuan silently thought.

Reversing time, going against the current, is a capability owned only after fully understanding the Complete Rule of Time.

The previous methods like speeding up time and others can be executed as long as there is some understanding of the Rule of Time.

…

“Over these years, the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force has also reached sixty strands…”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness sank into his mind, looked towards the Door to the Myriad Realms, and felt it briefly.

The three-thousand-meter-long Eternal Spatial Rift in Battlefield No. B0001 had increased the speed at which Lin Yuan accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force to one strand every one hundred and fifty days.

Over the years, Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the Ninth Rank and the rest period that followed added up to about twenty years, with thirty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force already accumulated beforehand.

All together, it just exceeded sixty strands.

“Sixty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force… fully capable of supporting a physical body transference…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Physical body transference, not just a different method from Consciousness Descent, is also an almost unsolvable way of escaping danger.

Even when facing a Supreme Being, capable of dominating the multiple spatial layers of the main universe, it is impossible to pursue across dimensional realms.

So far, the only instance Lin Yuan had seen someone surpass dimensional realms was at the Door to the Myriad Realms.

…

“You go to Battlefield No. B0001 and bring back the Taiyang Divine Spirit,” he instructed as he looked towards the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

At this moment, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit had caught up with the True Body in terms of assimilating the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd. Now, it was the Taiyang Divine Spirit’s turn.

…

Battlefield No. B0001.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit silently vanished.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit took its place, gazing at the nearby thirty-thousand-meter-long Eternal Spatial Rift.

“It’s too unbelievable,” he remarked.

“Is this the level of attack from a Supreme Being?”

Lin Yuan gazed at the Eternal Spatial Rift in awe.

Before reaching the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan’s view of this Eternal Spatial Rift remained merely on its most superficial aspect.

But now, as a Ninth Rank Evolver, he could see through the multiple spatial layers at a glance. Lin Yuan discovered that this Eternal Spatial Rift not only tore through the space of the main universe but also ripped apart the spaces within the multiple spatial layers.

It was unknown how many spatial layers were affected.

At least the more than forty thousand spatial layers Lin Yuan observed were like this.

Lin Yuan could imagine, in the distant past, an Evolver wielding a supreme weapon casually launching an attack forward.

This attack was crude and overbearing, requiring no finesse. No matter which spatial layer you hid in, all layers would be torn through; there was no escape.

This was the strike of a Supreme Being!

…

Milky Way Main Star.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit returned successfully.

After advancing to the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan’s speed increased significantly. Even without the World Tree to replenish the mental exhaustion of the two Divine Spirits, they were far superior to what they had been before.

The distance from Battlefield No. B0001 to the Milky Way Star Region was far less than the distance from the Milky Way Star Region to the Central Star Domain.

“Start absorbing now,” he directed.

Lin Yuan handed the Mysterious Gourd to the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

He then closed his eyes to reflect on the Dao.

In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit had also absorbed the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd up to the fifth type, the green liquid, catching up to Lin Yuan’s progress.

Rumbling.

Inside the Taiyang Divine Spirit, the World of Flames roared turbulently. Layers upon layers of space were opened and derived, with the entire size of the World of Flames reaching more than a hundred million miles in diameter.

“Not bad at all,” Lin Yuan appraised after glancing at the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Although understanding the Complete Space Rules meant that the size of the inner world was no longer restricted by the perfection of the rules, which typically would reach ten million miles in diameter.

However, the type of rules mastered still affected the ‘nature’ of the inner world. The inner world of the Taiyang Divine Spirit was a World of Flames, while that of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit was a world of cold darkness.

As for Lin Yuan’s True Body, its inner world was no different from a normal world.

“I wonder if the size of the inner world would remain the same if I let the Taiyang Divine Spirit transform from real to abstract and return to the Primordial Spirit Body?” Lin Yuan pondered momentarily.

“Well, I’ll try it later,” he decided.

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, “Let’s visit the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.”

The physical body of the Taiyang Divine Spirit was entirely condensed according to Lin Yuan’s True Body. Naturally, many evolutionary paths were the same, including the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path.

Now, responding to the calling from the ‘Xuanhuang’ Secret Realm, besides Lin Yuan’s True Body, both Divine Spirit avatars could also feel it.

Whoosh.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit stood up.

Its figure vanished from the spot.
